correctness.rationale: The fixed-unit mixed associativity identity gives a unique rank-nine linear family of second multiplications from all 27 structure coefficients. All 27 triple associators are expanded over Z. Six necessary equations imply an exhaustive b≠0 / b=0,c≠0 / b=c=0 case split; the last stratum is equivalent to exactly three rank-one 3x2 minors. Each closed component is verified associative, with geometric irreducibility and dimension by the rank-one parameterization. Inclusion–exclusion of explicit pairwise and triple intersections proves N_q=q^5+2q^4-2q^2 for all prime powers, its Grothendieck class and zeta. The packaged standard-library verifier reports VERIFY_OK and exhaustive q=2,3 checks, which supplement rather than replace proof.

value.rationale: K[t]/(t^3) is the simplest monogenic nonsemisimple unital local algebra beyond dual numbers, and the question of all compatible second multiplications is intrinsic to algebra pencils and deformation theory. Its full parameter space is reducible with dimension-jumping components 5,4,3; the widely natural mutation subspace is only a small component, not dominant. Exact all-characteristic finite-field counts and zeta follow from a complete classification; this is not an arbitrary parameter slice or known-table recomputation.
